reviews.title: Great shoe, relatively low arch, inside posting
reviews.body:
I ordered these for my husband who runs a great deal (80+ marathon completions). The feedback below is from him.

The shoe fits nicely and as expected. I do wear running shoes a couple of sizes larger than everyday shoes to protect my toenails. They do include a top wrap which hugs your foot nicely as advertised. Running shoe fit is very personal for everyone, but these match my need perfectly. They include a bit of extra posting on the interior which helps with my overpronation. They do not include a really high arch and I find this very comfortable. The shape of the lower back of the heal is perfect for foot strike runners to roll through each stride. The cushioning is excellent without being too soft for comfortable running.

The uppers breathe nicely to keep your feet cool. The laces with the top wrap hold them securely on your feet without binding or slipping.

This is a first class running shoe. After having run for years in a different shoe, there is a good chance I will switch to this entirely.

reviews.title: All great but 1 thing…
reviews.body:
I was really excited about these shoes. I have had ultra boost in the past and they are some of the most comfortable shoes I have tried so when I saw this product I thought I needed to give it a try.

The shoes themselves are really comfortable. Since it was made of recycled material I was a little concerned about the quality of the shoes but after checking them out, I have confidently say that there is nothing wrong with them. If you have tried ultraboost in the past and find them comfortable, than you know exactly what you are getting here.

One thing I will say about these shoes is that they were a little tight on the top of my foot. I hope this gets better with the more that I use them otherwise I might have to get half a size bigger.

I hope this review helps you make an educated purchasing decision.
